TanStack Router validateSearch with Zod.description:
Validate search params with a Zod schema; TanStack Router accepts any Standard Schema validator directly. catch keeps a malformed URL usable instead of throwing. Requires zod and createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

用 Zod schema 校验 search 参数，TanStack Router 直接接受任何 Standard Schema 校验器；catch 让格式不合法的 URL 仍可用而不是抛错；需要 zod，以及 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute。

TanStack Router validateSearch by hand (.description:
Validate search params with a plain function when no schema library is in use; the return type is what every consumer of this route sees. Requires createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

不引入 schema 库时用普通函数校验 search 参数，其返回类型即该路由所有使用方看到的类型；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute。

TanStack Router search middleware.description:
Carry chosen search params across navigations and keep default values out of the URL. Requires retainSearchParams, stripSearchParams and createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

让选定的 search 参数跨导航保留，并把默认值从 URL 中剔除；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 retainSearchParams、stripSearchParams 与 createFileRoute。
